name: certification-store
description: Internal catalog of certification exams with Gen AI study plan generation.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix client -- --watch=false && npm run typecheck --prefix server
